about: The capture vaults (work/27): normal sgit vaults (not pack vaults) on dev.send.sgraph.ai. A new vault opens before one reaches 20,000 files (admin/tools/capture.mjs rotates at 15,000). Vault ids only: the keys stay outside git (~/.sg-send/captures/<dir>/.sg_vault/local/, 0600), and a copy is sealed to the lead's key.

vaults.note: PRIVATE FOREVER, never publish its read key: its history holds organiser-page captures with guest lists (security finding 21). Event captures deleted from its working tree at 2026-11-11T13:26Z; history remains in the vault, which only the lead can open.
Privacy-safe captures only: Luma event headers (images hidden, cropped, text cut before guest markers), once a day; our own pages hourly. Read key not published until the lead says.
Event cover images only (work/45). Its read key is to be published (Dinis, brief 7/13: covers only, no guest lists).
